E400.description: Validation, signature, expiry or policy-input rejection

E404.description: Unknown identity, mandate, receipt, environment or route

E421.description: Host header is not a loopback name with the bound port

ActionInput.description: Unsigned request fields; only usable for agents whose key is held by this local service.
ActionInput.title: ActionInput

Bundle.description: Everything an offline verifier needs: receipt, invocation (with chain) and known revocations.
Bundle.title: Bundle

Capability.description: What a delegation grants. A child delegation may only narrow every field of its parent.
Capability.title: Capability

DataIntegrityProof.description: Autheo profile of a W3C Data Integrity proof (eddsa-jcs-2022, single proof).
DataIntegrityProof.title: DataIntegrityProof

Decision.description: Policy-decision-point result. Not a capability token and not an execution result.
Decision.title: Decision

DelegateInput.description: Sign a delegation with a key held by this local service (demo / local-dev custody only).
DelegateInput.title: DelegateInput

Delegation.description: A W3C VC 2.0 credential by which issuer (a DID) delegates a capability to credentialSubject.id.
Delegation.title: Delegation

Invocation.description: Invoker-signed request to use the capability at the end of the embedded delegation chain.
Invocation.title: Invocation

InvokeInput.description: Unsigned invocation fields; only usable when the invoker's key is held by this local service.
InvokeInput.title: InvokeInput

MatchSet.description: Glob allow/deny lists. Deny wins. An empty allow list means "no extra restriction".
MatchSet.title: MatchSet

ReceiptBody.description: Body of a signed autheo-receipt+jwt. Hash-linked to its predecessor.
ReceiptBody.title: ReceiptBody

ReceiptV2.description: Environment-signed, hash-linked record of a decision or an accepted revocation.
ReceiptV2.title: ReceiptV2

Revocation.description: Signed statement that a delegation (and everything below it) is revoked from revoked_at on.
Revocation.title: Revocation

RevocationInput.description: Record a signed revocation, or sign one with a service-held key (issuer + chain [+ index]).
RevocationInput.title: RevocationInput

RevocationList.description: Unsigned container: every record is independently signed, so anyone may relay a list.
RevocationList.title: RevocationList

info.description: Loopback-only local reference API. Decisions are simulations recorded as signed, hash-chained receipts; nothing is executed and no wallet or payment is involved. v1 signature rules: docs/SPEC-SIGNATURES.md. v2 DID identities, delegation chains, revocation and offline verification: docs/SPEC-DID.md.
info.title: Autheo Agent Environment local trust API

post.summary: Verify a decision bundle back to a root DID (pure; offline verifier)
Sign an attenuated delegation with a service-held key (local dev)
Verify a delegation chain (pure; same as the offline verifier)

get.summary: DIDs whose keys this local service holds (local-dev custody)

post.summary: Generate a did:key with local-dev custody (no registration anywhere)

get.summary: Resolve a DID document (did:key offline; did:web from cache unless enabled)

decision.description: Null when an identical request_id is replayed

post.summary: Evaluate one action; records a signed decision receipt. Never executes.
Admit a checkpoint at its destination; grants no authority
Issue an agent passport (agent-held public key, or local-dev generated key)
Revoke the agent passport in every environment

get.summary: Issuer, key id, public key, environments and active policy digest

post.summary: Verify an invocation and its delegation chain, apply policy, record a v2 receipt; returns an offline-verifiable bundle. Never executes.

get.summary: Export the v2 (DID) receipt chain for offline verification
Verify a ledger (signatures, links, identity, triggers, optional anchor)

post.summary: Grant a scoped, budgeted, short-lived mandate

get.summary: Mandate status: spent, remaining, revoked, expiry

post.summary: Revoke a mandate (recorded as a signed receipt)
Record an executor-reported outcome for an allowed decision
Verify a receipt signature and its ledger membership
Record a signed revocation (or sign one with a service-held key)
Add/remove a root DID whose delegation chains an environment accepts
